newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai oil agency to set up Philippines venture.
newsitem.headline: Thai oil agency to set up Philippines venture.

text.p: The Thai cabinet on Tuesday approved a plan by the state-run Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT) to invest in operations in the Philippines, a government statement said.
PTT would set up a company called PTT Philippines which would be wholly owned by it, the statement added.

PTT Philippines would invest in four joint-venture companies with another private firm Coastal Aruba Refining Company on 50-50 basis, it said without giving financial or other details of companies with whom the ventures were planned.
These companies included the Subic Bay Petroleum Products (Cayman Island) which would trade petroleum in southeast Asia, not including Thailand and the Philippines.
Subic Bay Petroleum (Philippines) would be set up to trade petroleum and rent oil related equipment.
Another joint venture --Pipeline and Clark Depot Company -- would be involved in pipeline transportation business while Subic petroleum Distribution will do oil trading business in the Philippines.
